body.p: People gather in a room and talk about matter, reason, and the shape of the world. The air is plain, the light is weak, and the voices move in small circles.
We notice a table, a print, a lamp, and some ordinary books. The discussion turns to science, doubt, and curiosity, while the garden outside stays quiet and still.

There is no need for a grand story. The simple fact is enough: mind, body, and speech all belong to the same world of action and observation. Nature is mentioned again, as if it were an old and familiar witness.
